color.note: One theme, Night. Depth comes from three surface steps, never shadows. Signal colours only ever mean their state, and every state also carries a word and a mark shape.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background and the queue pane. The base every text colour is checked against.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Grouped content sitting on ground: the why block, side boxes, the key legend's key caps.

tokens.name: raise
tokens.usage: Hovered queue rows, secondary key buttons, the pressed segment. The highest surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows, panes and table cells. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, key buttons and checkboxes: 3.6:1 on ground, 3.0:1 on raise.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the promise mark on ground, panel and raise (12.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: role and company lines, unselected row summaries, reason tails. 6.4:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Mono labels, ages, counts and key legends on ground, panel and raise (4.6:1 or better). Lighter than it looks: never go dimmer.

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: The one accent. Selected row edge, primary key button fill, focus ring, notes in the contact heat row. 8.7:1 on ground.

tokens.name: select-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the selected queue row. Always paired with the select edge; never the only sign of selection.

tokens.name: on-select
tokens.usage: Text and key caps on a select fill (8.7:1).

tokens.name: late
tokens.usage: Overdue only: late group headers, ages such as 3d late, the late reason, the overdue promise mark. Always beside the word late.

tokens.name: meeting
tokens.usage: The meeting-today diamond and meetings in the contact heat row. Nothing else.

tokens.name: renewal
tokens.usage: The renewal triangle and a kept promise's checkbox. Means ahead of time, not success in general.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Semi-condensed so a queue row holds a name, a task and an age at 420px. Weight carries hierarchy; size changes are few.

styles.name: type-title
styles.usage: The selected action's headline and a person's name. One per pane.

styles.name: type-heading
styles.usage: Empty-state headings and box titles that need weight.

styles.name: type-body
styles.sample: Due 3 days ago. You said Monday, on the call.
styles.usage: Reasons, notes and the log. Bold (600) for the part of a reason that matters.

styles.name: type-row
styles.sample: Nadia O.   Send the revised scope doc
styles.usage: Queue rows. The name at 600, the task at 400 in ink-muted until selected.

styles.name: type-small
styles.usage: Key button labels, role lines, secondary copy.

styles.name: type-brand
styles.usage: The wordmark in the top bar, uppercase. Nowhere else.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Mono for anything counted, timed or labelled, so columns of ages and values line up.

styles.name: type-figure
styles.usage: Money and counts in fact strips and tables.

styles.name: type-meta
styles.usage: Ages in queue rows, dates in the log, progress counts.

styles.name: type-label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, group headers and column heads, always in ink-faint or a signal colour.

styles.name: type-key
styles.usage: The letter on a key cap.

spacing.note: 4px base. Dense on purpose: the queue is scanned, not read.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Key cap to its label, mark to text inside a row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Queue row vertical padding, gaps between key buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside boxes and fact cells, between a row's columns.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Queue row side padding, top bar and footer side padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between blocks in the detail pane.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Detail pane padding, between the relationship's sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Detail pane side padding at desktop width.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, contact heat cells, the wordmark square.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Key buttons, key caps, inputs, boxes, the why block, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: A person's initials tile and the outer frame of the app.

layout.note: The fixed frame of the desk. Everything else flows.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar: wordmark, where you are, scope, counts.

tokens.name: footbar-height
tokens.usage: Footer: the key legend and the day's progress.

tokens.name: queue-width
tokens.usage: Maximum queue pane width beside the detail pane (minimum 300px).

tokens.name: mark-size
tokens.usage: The box every reason mark is centred in.
